福爾摩沙小導遊臺南 Tainan・中西區

全美戲院Chuan Mei Theater

認識這家 1950 年開業的老戲院、在這裡愛上電影的李安，以及畫了半世紀手繪看板的顏振發師傅。

Meet a cinema from 1950, the director who fell in love with movies here, and the master who paints its billboards by hand.

永福路上有一家 1950 年開業的戲院，以巨幅手繪電影看板聞名。它最早叫第一全成戲院；1969 年改名全美，1971 年起兩片同映、一票價。一位叫李安的高中生常坐在這裡看電影，後來拿下兩座奧斯卡最佳導演獎。看板出自顏振發師傅之手。他十八歲學畫，兩年就出師獨立。他用格子放大海報，畫在一塊塊帆布板上。靠近看，每一道筆觸都看得見。畫了五十多年，顏師傅也開課傳承手藝；2025 年，戲院滿 75 歲。

On Yongfu Road stands a cinema from 1950, famous for its giant hand-painted movie billboards. It opened as the First Chuan Cheng Theater. In 1969 it became Chuan Mei, and from 1971 one ticket bought two films. A high school boy named Ang Lee often sat in these seats. He later won two Oscars for Best Director. The billboards are painted by Master Yan Zhen-fa. He began learning at eighteen and went independent just two years later. He enlarges each poster with a grid and paints it on canvas panels. Look closely, and you can see every brush stroke. After more than fifty years at the easel, Master Yan has taught the craft to others. In 2025, the theater turned 75.

為什麼值得來

Why it matters & history
  1. 七十五年的老戲院全美戲院 1950 年開業，是臺南最老的二輪戲院之一。Chuan Mei Theater opened in 1950. It is one of Tainan's oldest second-run cinemas.
  2. 李安的電影夢李安在臺南讀高中時，常到全美戲院看電影。As a high school student in Tainan, Ang Lee often watched movies here.
  3. 看板師傅顏振發全美的招牌是手繪電影看板，執筆的是 1953 年出生的顏振發師傅。The theater's signature is the hand-painted billboard, by Master Yan Zhen-fa, born in 1953.

認識景點

About the place

七十五年的老戲院A theater since 1950

第一全成戲院：1950 年以「第一全成戲院」之名開幕。 改名全美：1969 年吳義垣接手，改名為全美戲院。 兩片同映，一票價：1971 年起改放二輪片，半價又兩片同映，學生、家庭都愛來。 蝙蝠與海馬：三樓有蝙蝠與海馬浮雕：蝙蝠代表福氣，海馬代表多子多孫。

The First Chuan Cheng Theater: It opened in 1950 as the First Chuan Cheng Theater. A new name: In 1969, Wu Yi-yuan took it over and named it Chuan Mei. Two films, one ticket: From 1971 it showed second-run double features at low prices, loved by students and families. Bats and seahorses: Third-floor reliefs show bats for good fortune and seahorses for many children.

75 歲生日：2025 年戲院歡度 75 週年，並開始轉型，尋找老戲院的新可能。

Turning 75: In 2025 the theater turned 75 and began looking for new ways to stay alive.

李安的電影夢Ang Lee's movie dream

高中生影迷：學生時代的李安，最常造訪的地方就是全美戲院。 電影夢的起點：李安多次提到，這裡是孕育他電影夢的地方。 斷背山：2006 年，李安以《斷背山》拿下第一座奧斯卡最佳導演獎。 少年Pi的奇幻漂流：2013 年，他以《少年Pi》第二度獲得最佳導演，是首位兩度獲此獎的亞洲導演。

A high school film fan: As a student, this was the place Ang Lee visited most. Where the dream began: He has often named this theater as the birthplace of his movie dream. Brokeback Mountain: In 2006, he won his first Oscar for Best Director with Brokeback Mountain. Life of Pi: In 2013, Life of Pi made him the first Asian director to win Best Director twice.

臥虎藏龍：2000 年的武俠片，讓全世界看見華語電影。

Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon: His 2000 martial arts film showed Chinese-language cinema to the world.

看板師傅顏振發Master Yan and his brush

十八歲拜師：十八歲在延平戲院向陳峰永師傅學畫看板。 兩年出師：一般學徒要三年多，他兩年就獲師傅同意出師。 一個月兩、三百幅：電影業鼎盛時，他一個月要畫兩、三百幅看板。 格放法：在小海報上打格子，再按格子放大畫到大看板上。

An apprentice at eighteen: At eighteen he began learning at the Yanping Theater. On his own in two years: Most apprentices needed over three years; he went independent in two. Hundreds a month: In his youth he could paint two to three hundred posters a month. The grid method: He draws a grid on a small poster, then copies it square by square, much larger.

分塊拼起來：大看板分塊畫在帆布板上，再組起來；最大的一幅超過 20 塊、約三層樓高。 卓越貢獻獎：2024 年，顏振發獲頒臺北電影節「卓越貢獻獎」。 傳承手繪課：顏師傅曾與戲院合作開手繪看板課，讓這門技藝傳下去。

Panels like a puzzle: Big billboards are painted on separate canvas panels; his largest used over twenty. An award for a lifetime: In 2024 he received the Outstanding Contribution Award at the Taipei Film Festival. Teaching the craft: He has taught hand-painting classes with the theater, so the craft lives on.

實景照片

Photos on site

手繪電影看板 Hand-painted billboards

全美戲院的正面掛著三幅巨大的電影看板，每部電影的看板都是畫師一筆一筆手繪的。仔細看，還能看到一塊一塊拼起來的接縫。這棟老戲院 1950 年開幕，當時叫「第一全成戲院」，1969 年改名「全美戲院」。

Three giant movie billboards hang on the front of Chuan Mei Theater. Each giant movie poster is painted by hand, one brush stroke at a time. Look closely and you can see the seams between the panels. This old theater opened in 1950 as the First Chuan Cheng Theater, and got the name Chuan Mei in 1969.

換上新看板 New billboards

換一天再來，正面的看板全換了！每次有新的電影或表演，就會畫上新的看板，所以戲院的正面一直在變。仔細看，其中一幅是舞蹈表演的看板，不是電影喔。

Come back another day, and the billboards are all new! Each time new shows come, new billboards are painted, so the front keeps changing. Look closely: one of these billboards is for a dance show, not a movie.
